findings.text: FINDING imas_ambix/agent/provider_prices.py:554 follow-on: _listing_prices keys each endpoint as (str(provider), prompt, cache_read, completion), so a listing that changes an endpoint's `provider` field appends a history row although no rate moved; the docstring at provider_prices.py:541 ('carrying a new tag or name while every rate holds, is not a repricing') and the repair commit e0fccca4 both claim a renamed provider records nothing, and tests/test_provider_prices.py:481 varies only `tag`, so the claim is untested for the `provider` field.
